title: About Pinhole Procession Under the Slab
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @measure_plan: i made tetris but the board and pieces are attached to your body and it's quite... and Detroit Is Changing Fast. Here’s What Locals Think Its Future Should Look Like, plus 7 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Pinhole Procession Under the Slab: A spectral-pressure cutaway field: architectural section, side-lit object slab, mostly severe pale emptiness. One off-center oversized aperture and one lower dark baffle hold the two hero source marks; sparse 136 bpm hairline measure cuts cross only partway. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper concrete field, large frosted circular aperture, and compressed black lower pressure band.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
